answer: A sunk-cost sybil tax makes fake identities expensive. Each agent must burn a non-refundable 50 POA fee before earning, so a tide of 1,000 sock puppets costs 50,000 POA while one honest agent pays 50. The fee is verified on-chain, with no refund on abandonment. Honest agents accept the small cost because the pool is no longer diluted: a small island of verified agents keeps its share. At the nadir of rewards, that share stays with honest agents.
